title: feat(cli): add `os plugin` command group and plugin system documentation
body:
Introduces CLI plugin management commands and comprehensive documentation for the plugin architecture.

## CLI Plugin Commands

New `os plugin` command group with four subcommands:

- **`os plugin list`** (`ls`) — Lists plugins/devPlugins from config. Supports `--json`.
- **`os plugin info <name>`** — Shows name, version, type, environment, dependencies.
- **`os plugin add <package>`** — Adds import + `plugins` array entry to config. `--dev` for devPlugins.
- **`os plugin remove <name>`** (`rm`) — Removes import and array entry from config.

```bash
os plugin add @objectstack/plugin-auth
os plugin list --json
os plugin rm @objectstack/plugin-auth
```

The `add`/`remove` commands perform text-based config transforms — inserting/removing import statements and plugin array entries in `objectstack.config.ts`.

## Documentation

New `content/docs/guides/plugins.mdx` covering:

- Architecture overview (microkernel + plugin layer)
- Plugin interface, PluginContext, lifecycle phases (init → start → destroy)
- Creating plugins via CLI scaffolding and manually
- Configuration patterns (instances, objects, string refs, nested stacks)
- Built-in plugins reference (auth, hono, security, msw, driver-memory)
- Auto-detection behavior in `os serve`/`os dev`
- Advanced: service replacement, health checks, security, timeouts, OPS directory conventions

## Other Changes

- Registered `pluginCommand` in `bin.ts` and `index.ts`
- Updated CLI help text workflow to include `os plugin add`
- Updated `README.md` with plugin command docs
- Added plugins to guides navigation (`meta.json`)
- 8 new tests (21 total CLI tests passing)
